Submit an opportunity

Running a hackathon, case competition or research programme for students? Send it to us and we will list it for free, with the prize, deadline and eligibility, and a link to your official page.

What we need

  • The official page or registration link
  • The name of the organizer
  • The prize or stipend, the deadline and who can apply

Submit on GitHub ↗

Already listed?

Every listing has its own page here. Linking to it from your event page or announcement helps students find you, and helps Prizd reach more of them.
